item.title_tr: Q71 TWS Wireless Bluetooth Headset with LED Display Sports Gamer Microphone Android iPhone
item.description_tr:
🎧 Wireless Bluetooth 5.4 Headphones – Hi-Fi Sound, Comfort, and Freedom


Enjoy your music, videos, games, and calls with more convenience. With Bluetooth 5.4, ergonomic design, and high-quality audio, these headphones offer a comfortable experience for everyday use, whether at work, studying, at the gym, or traveling.

✨ Main advantages


✅ Bluetooth 5.4 – Fast, stable connection with low power consumption.


✅ Hi-Fi Sound – Powerful bass, balanced mid-range, and crisp highs for a more immersive sound experience.


✅ Low Latency – Ideal for gaming, video, and calls with synchronized audio.


✅ Integrated microphone – clearer calls and high-quality communication.


✅ Case with LED Display – Easily view the battery level of the case and earbuds.


🛋️ All-day comfort


✔ Ergonomic Design that fits comfortably in the ears.


✔ Lightweight and comfortable for extended use.


✔ A perfect fit for walking, running, gym workouts, and other sporting activities.


🎵 High Quality Audio


Enjoy Hi-Fi stereo sound with excellent definition for listening to music, watching movies, and playing games.


🎮 Gamer Mode – Low latency for greater precision during matches.


🎶 Music Mode – Balanced audio for a more enjoyable sound experience.


🚀 Bluetooth 5.4 technology


• Wireless range of up to 10 meters (without obstacles).


• Fast and stable connection.


• Automatic pairing after the first connection.


• Compatible with Android, iPhone, tablets and laptops with Bluetooth.


💦 Ideal for various occasions.


✔ Academy


✔ Race


✔ Hiking


✔ Work


✔ Studies


✔ Travel


✔ Voice calls


🎨 Modern Design


Compact case with digital battery display, easy to carry in your pocket or backpack.


AVAILABLE COLORS:


🖤 Black


🤍 Beige


💜 Purple


📦 SPECIFICATIONS


• Model: BM-228


• Bluetooth 5.4


• Type: Wireless Earphones (TWS)


• Integrated microphone


• LED Digital Display


• Range: Up to 10 meters


• Compatible with Android and iPhone


📦 Package contents


• 2 x Bluetooth Headphones


• 1 x Charging Case


• 1 x USB Charging Cable


• 1 × User Manual


⭐ Key differentiators


✔ Next-generation Bluetooth 5.4


✔ Hi-Fi stereo sound


✔ Low latency for gaming


✔ Integrated microphone


✔ LED Battery Display


✔ Lightweight, comfortable and portable.


✔ Compatible with Android and iPhone.


👉 Buy now and enjoy high-quality sound, a stable connection, and much more comfort for listening to music, playing games, and answering calls wherever you are!
